It is shown for review, not as a verified issue. **Preserve support for non-public constructors.** If a class using `HasCopyWith` has a private or protected constructor and calls `copyWith()`, this call throws `ReflectionException`. `ReflectionClass::newInstanceArgs()` requires a public constructor. The previous `new static(...)` call ran in the class scope where the trait is used, so that class could invoke its own non-public constructor. Preserve a construction path that supports this case. ([php.net](https://www.php.net/manual/en/reflectionclass.newinstanceargs.php?utm_source=openai))
